description: CLAUDE.md has no frontmatter `name` field; NLPM scanner cannot register or name this artifact.
suggested_fix: Add YAML frontmatter block with name: claude-project-config (or appropriate slug).

description: CLAUDE.md has no frontmatter `description` field; discovery tooling that requires description will error.
suggested_fix: Add `description: Project-level Claude Code instructions, delegates to AGENTS.md` to frontmatter.

description: xlsx@^0.18.5 is the last open-source SheetJS release; effectively unmaintained since 2023 license change with no security backports; known CVEs unresolved in this line.
suggested_fix: Replace with exceljs or @e965/xlsx; audit file-parsing codepaths for path-traversal after migration.

description: Production dependencies marked, modern-screenshot, and xlsx use ^ semver ranges; minor-version drift possible on pnpm update in CI or local environments.
suggested_fix: Pin exact versions in package.json or use pnpm catalog: protocol for version governance.

description: Body is 4 lines with no output format: no HTML format declaration, no canvas dimensions, no rendering context. Agent cannot determine what to produce.
suggested_fix: Add explicit output format section: single-file HTML, viewport dimensions, and spring animation CSS property/duration constraints.

description: 9-line body with no output format specification. 'CSS 动效' implies HTML but neither canvas size nor single-file output is declared.
suggested_fix: Add output format: 1920x1080 single-file HTML with @keyframes animations; specify animation duration range and loop behavior.

description: Body lists content sections (schedule, buddy card, checklist) with no HTML/CSS/dimension anchors; output format entirely absent.
suggested_fix: Add 'single-file HTML, long-page layout' declaration and note any Tailwind CDN requirement.

description: Body lists content sections (problem, KPIs, user stories) with no output format. Could be interpreted as a document or a web page.
suggested_fix: Add explicit output format: single-file HTML long-page with status pill, Tailwind CDN.

description: Body lists UI areas (platform switcher, KPI cards, chart) with no output format, canvas size, or chart library specified.
suggested_fix: Add output format: 1440px desktop single-file HTML; specify Chart.js or ECharts for charts; add seed-data fallback note.

description: 8-line body; 'warm monochrome canvas' and 'ambient micro-motion' are design metaphors with no canvas size or output format declaration.
suggested_fix: Add 1440px desktop single-file HTML output declaration; specify hex for warm monochrome and easing for micro-motion.

description: 'lifestyle / creator brand 调子, 柔和米色' (soft beige lifestyle tone) gives no hex values or color constraints; agent must guess palette.
suggested_fix: Add hex range for beige (e.g., #f5ede0–#fffaf5) and specify font family for creator-brand tone.

description: '流畅可循环' (smooth loop) and '电影感调色' (cinematic color) lack timing values and hex constraints; each could produce very different outputs.
suggested_fix: Specify animation duration range (e.g., 8-14s), loop type (infinite alternate), and at least one example hex for the neon accent.

description: 'Spring motion (微反弹的 hover)' has no easing function, duration, or CSS property specified; agent will invent behavior.
suggested_fix: Add: transition: transform 300ms cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.56, 0.64, 1); as the spring easing spec.

description: '醒目的 quest tile 渐变' (eye-catching gradient) has no color, direction, or contrast constraint; agent must guess.
suggested_fix: Add gradient direction and at least two hex stops, e.g., linear-gradient(135deg, #7c3aed, #db2777).

description: '颜色统一一套调色板, 卡片之间渐进切换' (unified palette, progressive transitions) specifies no palette; agent must invent color scheme.
suggested_fix: Provide a default 2-3 color option set or at minimum specify lightness range (e.g., muted/saturated distinction).

description: 'Notion-callout / toggle / 数据库表配色风格' references a third-party design language without specifying concrete hex values or CSS.
suggested_fix: Extract Notion's callout colors (e.g., yellow #fef3b8, blue #dbeafe) and specify them explicitly.

description: 9-line body; no output format, no canvas dimensions. 'Newsprint canvas' and 'ASCII装饰' imply HTML but nothing is declared.
suggested_fix: Add 1440px single-file HTML output declaration; specify hazard-red hex and grotesque font name.

description: '不要规规矩矩的对齐' (not neatly aligned) provides intent but no concrete constraint on how misaligned elements should appear.
suggested_fix: Quantify: e.g., rotate up to ±4deg, offset up to 8px from grid, at least 2 elements must break column alignment.

description: 'editorial typography + 克制的高亮色' (restrained accent) specifies neither font family nor accent hex.
suggested_fix: Add a primary font (e.g., Source Serif Pro) and an accent hex (e.g., #d97757) to match the 'consumer product' aesthetic.

description: '复古调色板: 红 / 米 / 墨绿' names colors in natural language with no hex values; agent must choose arbitrary shades.
suggested_fix: Add hex values: 红 #cc3333, 米 #f5ede0, 墨绿 #1a3a2a (or similar vintage palette refs).

description: '干净通用' (clean and general) is the only design constraint; agent has no style anchor to differentiate this from other deck templates.
suggested_fix: Add at least a background hex, font choice, and accent color to anchor the 'simple' aesthetic.

description: '1-2 张主图表 (折线 / 柱 / 区域)' specifies no chart library or rendering approach; Chart.js vs ECharts vs SVG produces very different outputs.
suggested_fix: Add chart library preference (e.g., Chart.js via jsdelivr CDN) and minimum chart height constraint.

description: CLAUDE.md contains only '@AGENTS.md' with no standalone NL content or frontmatter; in an NLPM-aware project this file should carry metadata or expand the @-include with additional instructions.
suggested_fix: Either add NLPM frontmatter or promote relevant project-level NL guidance directly into CLAUDE.md alongside the @AGENTS.md include.

description: 16 of 75 skill files include example_id/example_name metadata while 59 do not, creating an invisible quality split; skills without examples have no test coverage signal in the platform.
suggested_fix: Add example_id and example_format fields to high-priority skills (poster-hero, hr-onboarding, kanban-board, docs-page, etc.) that lack examples.
